name: Ctrl
description: Touch controls for levels: objects of a group act as a button or can be dragged by a finger.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: button: pressing an object of the button group fires the triggers of the target group. drag: an object of the button group follows the finger.

button-group.name: Button group
button-group.description: Objects in this group react to touch.

target-group.name: Trigger group (button mode)
target-group.description: Triggers in this group are fired when the button is pressed (set them to Spawn Triggered).

hold-time.name: Hold time before drag (s)
hold-time.description: Drag mode: how long the finger must stay on the object before it can be dragged.
